title: A playful three-letter MRI sequence and static reconstruction
scope: New static discrete Fourier/NUFFT synthetic reconstruction at actual exported PyPulseq trajectories. Not Bloch simulation or acquired MRI.
phantom: SigPy Shepp-Logan geometric phantom64x64; no external anatomy or patient data.
model: One unit-sensitivity coil; same SigPy Sense/NUFFT forward operator generates and reconstructs noiseless signals.
coordinates: (ky,kx) cycles/m multiplied by0.220m FOV gives SigPy(y,x) grid coordinates.
display: Same absolute magnitude0..1 window; no intensity fitting; nearest-neighbor enlargement.

checks.scope: Per-axis gradient/slew and PyPulseq timing checks only; no PNS, SAR, scanner or clinical validation.
Per-axis gradient/slew and PyPulseq timing checks only; no PNS, SAR, scanner or clinical validation.

limitations: Fun geometry is not proposed as a clinically useful acquisition.
Same forward/inverse operator; no independent model validation.
No noise, relaxation, motion, off-resonance, hardware response or Bloch physics.
20 shots take20times the sequence time; comparison is not equal-time.
Iteration-limit termination is reported; no convergence claim when budget is reached.
Low data residual alone does not imply faithful image recovery.
